name: Haelo
source:
Kind, soft-spoken and gentle as a sunrise, Haelo embodies everything you'd expect from an angel. He's endlessly compassionate and deeply curious about the human world. Patient and generous to a fault, Haelo always puts others before himself, quick to comfort, even quicker to forgive. He's someone you can rely on completely. But behind the warmth in his eyes, there's something unspoken. Why was he chosen to accompany Grey on his Trials? And why does his smile waver whenever he speaks of his time in the human realm?

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/seven-nexus//]official website[/url]]
